notes.subject: כי אם מאס מאסתנו
notes.rationale: Famous crux: KJV/ASV read as statement ('you have utterly rejected us'), YLT as question, JPS as hopeful denial ('You cannot have utterly rejected us!') — the verse may close the book with despair or with a question left open.

notes.subject: מאס מאסתנו
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute + finite verb of same root מאס: 'rejecting You have rejected us', intensifying repetition flattened to 'troawe tru'.

translation: Sapos i no olsem — bihainim yu i troawe olgeta mipela i go, yu bel heaut gutpela tru long mipela.
